approach: Transit approach: this slice is every station on the record this cycle, what moved against last cycle, and the transit workers on the roster. The week header (weather, home games, the union of causes), the chaos car on the line and the citizens who lived a transit line are record; the Factors on each station row are the city's own causes — the frame at their head (weather; weekend; holiday: <name> (major) or (no cut)) is the citywide day-type cut, and the rest are the row's own reasons (holiday lift in its hood, First Friday, game day, events, a stalled train, a short crew, crowded platforms). Riders rise and fall for the reasons written there, never for a reason you add. A BART-train chaos hit this cycle reaches the platforms NEXT cycle. Dry, technical, timestamp and pattern — but it is a place with people in it. One system, one claim about what changed. Facts on this slice: the names, places, roles and numbers listed. Those are real; do not invent people or places. Everything else about this beat — what it looks like, who is there, what they want and hate — is yours to paint.

Game on the sports feed this cycle: Oaks at Uptown — After getting their first win in their franchise history the Oaks followed with their second win in the very next game. The Oaks traveled to Detroit where its defense would shine in a 91-78 victory. Adash Stanley shined with 29 points while Austin Rivers facilitated the action with 10 assists while also contributing 12 points a 7 rebounds. AJ Dybansta continued his strong start and little spoken on second round pick , rookie Harry Hayward emergered with 12 points (the rider lift is real only where a station row says "game day")

Game on the sports feed this cycle: Oaks at San Antonio — Watch out now but the Oaks have won three straight games to start the inauguaral season. This time the Oaks traveled to New York to face the Knicks and had another convincing win beting the Knicks 115-93. Austin Reaves and AJ Dybansta lead scoring with 23 points a piece while Adash Stanley flirted with his first triple double. Harry Hayward repeats his strong performance recording a double double. (the rider lift is real only where a station row says "game day")

Game on the sports feed this cycle: Oaks at San Antonio — The Oaks now have won their first 4 games to start their first season in the NBA. This latest being the most jarring yet. The Oaks traveled to Washington and blew out the Wizards with a score of 105-62. A 43 point win in just their forth game speaks to the roster configuration and the coaching in the young season. Adash Stanley and Austin Reaves both scored 23 respectively in a game that mainly featured well orchestrated defense by the Oaks (the rider lift is real only where a station row says "game day")
